title: How to Swap a Head in an Image with Codex MCP and Medux
description: This guide turns the screen-recorded workflow into a clean publish-ready tutorial. Codex reads the request, calls the Medux MCP tool, uploads two local images, runs the head-swap task, polls the result, and returns the final image.
operation: This guide turns the screen-recorded workflow into a clean publish-ready tutorial. Codex reads the request, calls the Medux MCP tool, uploads two local images, runs the head-swap task, polls the result, and returns the final image.
prompt: Swap the head in "swap_head_src.jpg" with the head in "swap_head_target.jpg". Use medux. head swap!
